description: This file contains a helper class for integrating with OpenAI's API, providing methods to generate prompts for code analysis, improvement, and simulation, as well as a method to call the GPT-4 API and extract code blocks from text.

classes.name: OpenAIHelper
classes.description: A helper class for interacting with OpenAI API, generating prompts for code review and improvement, and processing responses.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAIHelper instance and creates an OpenAI client.

methods.name: _create_openai_client
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAI client using the API key.

methods.name: generate_initial_scoring_query
methods.description: Generates a prompt to evaluate the quality and optimizeability of a function.

methods.name: generate_improvement_query
methods.description: Creates a prompt to suggest improvements for a function based on its implementation and context.

methods.name: generate_simulation_query
methods.description: Prepares a prompt to simulate and verify the correctness of a function with given input and output examples.

methods.name: generate_after_insert_style_query
methods.description: Creates a prompt to ensure style consistency after programmatic code modifications.

methods.name: call_chatgpt
methods.description: Sends a query to GPT-4 API and returns the generated response.

methods.name: extract_first_code_block
methods.description: Extracts the first code block from a text, removing language specifier if present.
